title: Hawassa demonstration supporting continued government enforcement measures
location: Millennium Square, Hawassa, Sidama Regional State, Ethiopia
crowd_size_evidence: Fana/FBC contemporaneous article reports thousands at this gathering, sufficient for the 50-person threshold; exact count and upper bound not given.

attendance.value: Thousands reported by Fana/FBC; clearly at least 50, but exact count unspecified

state_targeted_demand.value: Pro-government participants explicitly demanded continuation of law-enforcement measures against TPLF; demand is directed to Ethiopian government policy

inclusion_exclusion.value: Not described as an electoral rally; public political mobilization around continuing federal enforcement policy. Verify against manual at review.

episode_onset_neighbor.value: Fana calls this the first observed day and later reports a second and third day across towns; exact national organization/site overlap and whether this is one national action or separate local actions remain unresolved. December searches did not surface a continuation, within documented search limits.

decision_note: Occurrence, site, threshold and explicit government-policy demand are supported by one contemporaneous local outlet. Episode/onset ownership across the Nov11–14 multi-town series needs follow-up; no independent corroboration quota is imposed, and no count is pooled.

title: Reported multi-town demonstrations supporting government action against TPLF
location: Reported in Semera and Logia (Afar); Jimma, Agaro, Buno Bedele, Ghimbi, Goro Dola, Harerge and Arsi Zone (Oromia); Jigjiga (Somali Region); Hawassa (Sidama); ENA also says other areas. Attendance cannot be attributed to any individual town.
crowd_size_evidence: ENA body reports demonstrations but no headcount per named location; qualifying threshold unknown at each site and cannot be pooled across towns.

occurrence_and_date.value: ENA reports demonstrations held Nov12 in listed towns/regions

location.value: Multiple individually named towns; no aggregate event location assumed

attendance.value: No count by site; threshold unverified

state_targeted_demand.value: Participants reportedly used slogans in support of government action; no direct demand that government take/continue a policy is clearly reported for each site

inclusion_exclusion.value: Executed public demonstrations are described; do not classify as a single nationwide event without evidence of national organization.

episode_onset_neighbor.value: ENA predicts additional demonstrations; later Nov13–14 Fana reports refer to consecutive days, but organizer/site overlap not established. December follow-up did not surface a link.

decision_note: Do not pool attendees or treat expected future demonstrations as executed events. Coverage follow-up should find site-specific people counts and evidence of domestic-state demand, if any.

title: Adama demonstration demanding stronger government military action
location: Adama City, Oromia Regional State, Ethiopia
crowd_size_evidence: Fana/FBC says hundreds of Adama residents and environs participated, clearly meeting 50; no more exact number.

location.value: Adama City; report also refers broadly to environs, but no other location count is assigned

attendance.value: Hundreds of Adama residents and environs reported

state_targeted_demand.value: Demonstrators directly demanded that Ethiopian government reinforce its offensive and end TPLF actions

inclusion_exclusion.value: Public demonstration tied to government policy; not an electoral rally in the reviewed account.

episode_onset_neighbor.value: Same outlet describes second-day multi-town demonstrations on Nov13 after Nov11 first-day Hawassa rally; relation to Nov12 and Nov14 sites/series needs episode ownership research. No Dec continuity found in current searches.

decision_note: Threshold and explicit domestic-state policy demand are supported for this site/date. Keep episode assignment pending due the same multi-town three-day series; do not pool.

title: Wolayta Sodo demonstration supporting government enforcement action
location: Multi-Purpose Stadium, Wolayta Sodo, Wolayta Zone, Ethiopia
crowd_size_evidence: Fana/FBC says hundreds of residents of Sodo; site-specific, no exact count.

state_targeted_demand.value: Participants expressed support for current government law-enforcement measures; no unambiguous forward demand to domestic government is stated

inclusion_exclusion.value: Public demonstration, but eligibility under home-grown anti-state demand definition needs review because source describes state-policy support, not a clear request for redress.

episode_onset_neighbor.value: Article labels third day of consecutive multi-town demonstrations; link/organization with Nov11 Hawassa and Nov13 Adama not resolved. December follow-up did not surface continuation.

decision_note: Executed and site-specific threshold is reported. Demand is support for state action rather than a clearly articulated request; do not promote without review. Attendance is not pooled with Haramaya.

title: Haramaya demonstration supporting government enforcement action
location: Haramaya town, West Hararghe Zone, Oromia Regional State, Ethiopia
crowd_size_evidence: Fana/FBC reports hundreds of demonstrators from several West Hararghe districts at the rally in Haramaya; no more exact count.

location.value: Haramaya town; demonstrators reportedly drawn from West Hararghe districts

attendance.value: Hundreds reported separately for Haramaya; no pooling with Sodo

state_targeted_demand.value: Participants endorsed ongoing government measures against TPLF and pledged support; no explicit request for redress or demand of state is clear

inclusion_exclusion.value: Not an election rally; however support for state action may not meet anti-state demand requirement. Keep pending.

episode_onset_neighbor.value: Article reports this as part of third consecutive day; group/site relation to prior rallies and national organization unresolved; no Dec continuity surfaced in scoped search.

decision_note: Site-specific executed gathering and hundreds supported. Do not merge/pool across sites; state-targeted demand remains unresolved.
